title: Innokin Endura V Pod Vape Kit
description: The Innokin Endura V Pod Kit is crafted for vapers who seek a smooth and flavourful MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping experience from a simple-to-use device. The kit is powered by a 1200mAh battery, providing up to three days of vaping on a single charge, ensuring you can enjoy uninterrupted vaping pleasure. The device features a top-fill design for easy and mess-free refills, with 2ml capacity VCAP pods. Innokin’s VCAP pods come with three different coil options: 0.6ohm (included) best at 18W, 0.8ohm best at 15W, and 1.2ohm best at 12W, all designed to enhance flavour and extend the pod lifespan up to 30ml of e-liquid. The precision 3-hole airflow control located on the side of the device allows you to find your perfect draw, whether you prefer a tighter or looser inhale. The Endura V also includes a 3-level battery indicator, making it easy to monitor your battery life at a glance. Available in six stunning colours, this kit combines style, performance, and convenience in one compact package. When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil. Elevate your sessions by pairing this kit with premium vape juices . We recommend paring this kit with 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquids Please note: This kit will require a USB Charging Cable. You can purchase a USB-C Charging Cable here.
